What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing anything, which let her say that taking it would admit something, and you never answered who decided on the zero.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you brought no evidence, so you never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
